scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
That Veronica...
Hah! Best hair dresser my ass.
She's not the best hair dresser...
...
I am!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
那个维罗妮卡...
哈！什么最好的发型师，真是笑话。
她根本不是最好的发型师...
...
我才是！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
I, Rui Vishop, the man to whom
all scalps are canvases
waiting to be transformed into
works of magnificent art~!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
我，鲁伊·维绍普，所有头骨都是我的画布，
等待被我雕琢成宏伟艺术品的男人~！

scripts.text: What are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Do my hair, please!
scripts.translation: 请帮我做头发！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Do you not know that I, Rui
Vishop, maestro of the shears
and sculptor of hair, am an
artist far ahead of his time?!
Well, I suppose an adventurer
like yourself wouldn't know...
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
你不知道吗？我，鲁伊·维绍普，剪刀的大师，
头发的雕塑家，是一位超越时代的艺术家！
不过，像你这样的冒险者大概是不懂的...

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
As a hair sculptor, I find joy
in bestowing upon others the
supreme favour of doing their
hairstyle at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
作为一名发型雕塑家，我乐于以合理的价格，
赐予他人做发型的无上恩惠。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Recently, however, I happened to
overhear that some tyro has had
the audacity to call herself a
hair dresser.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
然而最近，我偶然听到有人胆大包天，
竟然自称是发型师。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
So one day I went there,
pretending to be a customer.
I was apalled to see the boring,
lifeless hairstyles that she was
giving all of her clients...
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
于是有一天，我假装成顾客去了那里。
令我震惊的是，她给所有顾客做的发型
都枯燥乏味，毫无生气...

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
It wasn't hard to notice that her
skills, or lack thereof, are a
joke. She brings shame to the
great and honorable
profession of hair dressing.
A complete and utter disgrace!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
很明显，她的技术，或者说是缺乏技术，
简直是个笑话。她给伟大而光荣的
发型师职业蒙羞。
简直是彻头彻尾的耻辱！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
But the worst part was...
she forced her customers to
choose a hairstyle before she
styled their hair!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
但最糟糕的是...
她竟然强迫顾客在做头发之前
先选择发型！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
That's not how talented hair
dressers do their job! She
should know what hair style will
fit a customer without ever
asking them!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
有才华的发型师不是这样工作的！
她应该不用问就知道什么发型
适合顾客！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
If by any chance you decide to
do your hair, don't even think
about giving her patronage.
Instead, you may ask for my
services. I assure you, I am
faaaar better than her.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
如果你碰巧决定要做头发，
千万别去找她。
相反，你可以请求我的服务。
我向你保证，我比她好得多。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Do you understand? I mean, don't
let her ruin your hair needlessly!
You could get a Swordman to hack
away at your hair if you want a
hairstyle that horrible~!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
你明白了吗？我是说，别让她
无端地毁掉你的头发！
如果你想要那么糟糕的发型，
找个剑士来砍你的头发就好了~！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Hmm, I must say, your current
style fits you best. Trust me, I know what I am saying.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
嗯，不得不说，你现在的发型
最适合你。相信我，我知道我在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Ah, I see that that you can
recognize genius when it is
right before you. In light
of your good taste, I will
only require money for my
services.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
啊，看来你能在我面前
认出天才。鉴于你的好品味，
我只需要收取金钱作为我的服务费用。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Simply pay me the small
fee of 199,800 zeny. You must
know that I am doing you a
huge favor by charging you
such a small amount. My
art is priceless, after all.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
只需支付我199,800 Zeny的小额费用。
你应该知道，我收取这么少的钱
是在给你天大的恩惠。毕竟，
我的艺术是无价的。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Alright, I will be taking my
199,800 zeny service charge now.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
好的，我现在将收取
199,800 Zeny的服务费。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
If you don't wish to do
this right now, though I can't
imagine why, you may ask that
stupid hair dresser to
do her clumsy work on you...
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
如果你不想现在做，虽然
我无法想象为什么，
你可以让那个愚蠢的发型师
对你做她笨拙的工作...

scripts.text: No, please do my hair.
scripts.translation: 不，请帮我做头发。

scripts.text: Umm, I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我改变主意了。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
O~k~a~y!
Now, let us begin~!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
好~的~！
那么，让我们开始吧~！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Wooooo~oooohhhh!! Toohhhhh~oooohhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
哇哦哦哦~哦哦哦！！
太~棒~了！！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Woooooo~aaaaaaahhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
哇哦哦哦~啊啊啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Voila!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
看！完成了！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Oh, great~ it's awesome!
Another Vishop masterpiece~
Once more I've outdone myself.
It's such a unique and talented
style! Yes, I am the best! Wooohahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
哦，太棒了~真完美！
又是维绍普的杰作~
我又一次超越了自己。
真是独特而充满才华的风格！
没错，我是最棒的！哇哦哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Bah! Alright! It's your decision.
But don't blame me later!
One day you'll wake up, realize
you're ugly and regret not
having my genius shape every lock
of hair on your head.
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
哼！好吧！这是你的决定。
但别怪我之后后悔！
总有一天你会醒来，
意识到自己很丑，
并后悔没有让我这位天才
为你打理每一缕头发。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
What? What a shame!
Will you let that...that
charlatan of a hair dresser ruin
your hairstyle!? I'm sure the
heavens are crying tears of
pity at mankind's ignorance...
scripts.translation:
[鲁伊·维绍普]
什么？真可惜！
你要让那个...那个
江湖骗子发型师
毁掉你的发型吗？！
我敢肯定，
上天正为人类的无知
流下同情的泪水...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Wah?! Sweet Jiminy,
you freaked me out!
What are you doing?!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇？！天哪，
你吓死我了！
你在干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh! Um, a customer!
H-h-h-h-h-hello! Can
I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哦！嗯，有顾客！
你...你好！
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: What do you do?
scripts.translation: 你是做什么的？

scripts.text: Please change my hairstyle.
scripts.translation: 请帮我换个发型。

scripts.text: Who is Prince Shammi?
scripts.translation: 王子 沙米是谁？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh! Me...? I'm
just an assistant
beautician, but I'm
training hard everyday
so that I can become
a real professional!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哦！我...？
我只是个美容助理，
但我每天都在努力练习，
希望能成为真正的专业人士！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Yeah, I do all sorts of
grunt work for the boss while
I'm in training. Sometimes, he
makes me work pretty hard.
In fact, I better get back to work before he gets angry at me!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
是的，我在训练期间
帮老板做各种杂活。
有时候，他让我
工作得很辛苦。
事实上，我最好赶紧回去工作，
免得他生我的气！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Me...? Oh no,
no I can't! I mean,
I'd love to but, I'm
still in training and
I can't take responsibility
if I mess up on a little kid!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我...？哦不，
我不行！我是说，
我很乐意，但我还在训练中，
如果我在小孩子身上
搞砸了，我没法承担责任！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Well... I'm just an
assistant, but I have been
studying hairstyling after
work. If you want, just bring
me 250,000 zeny and I'll try
my best to change your hair~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
嗯...我只是个助理，
但我下班后一直在
研究发型设计。如果你愿意，
只要给我250,000 Zeny，
我会尽力帮你换发型~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
I'd appreciate it if you'd
give me this chance! The
boss doesn't think I'm ready
for styling real people yet, so
I haven't had much practice!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
如果你能给我这个机会，
我会很感激的！
老板觉得我还不够成熟，
不能给真人做造型，
所以我没怎么练习过！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
I just know I could
do a good job on your
hair! Just... Just please
understand if I mess up.
It won't be too bad, I promise~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我只知道我能
把你的头发做得很好！
只是...请理解
如果我搞砸了。
不会太严重的，我保证~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
You're really going to
give me a chance to practice?
Oh, I love you so much! Okay,
I'll need 250,000 zeny to make
up for the material expenses.
Is that okay with you?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
你真的愿意给我
一个练习的机会？
哦，我太爱你了！好吧，
我需要250,000 Zeny来
弥补材料费用。
这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Of course~
scripts.translation: 当然~

scripts.text: On second thought...
scripts.translation: 再想想...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Great! Now, please
choose a hairstyle
from ''1'' to ''23.''
Um, if you need to
cancel, just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
太好了！现在，
请从''1''到''23''中
选择一个发型。
嗯，如果需要取消，
请输入''0''。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Awwww...
I guess you don't
trust me after all...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哎呀...
看来你终究还是
不信任我嘛...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Huh? I thought I asked
you to enter a number from
''1'' to ''23?'' What did I do
wrong this time? Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
咦？我以为我让你
输入''1''到''23''之间的
数字来着？我哪里做错了？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
So this is the
style you want me
to try to do for you?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
所以这就是你想让我
尝试为你做的
发型吗？

scripts.text: Yes, let's try it~
scripts.translation: 是的，试试看~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oooh, there must
be some style that
you like, right? Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
噢噢，肯定有
你喜欢的发型吧？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Great, you finally
picked one! What, which
one did you pick again?
Ah, I found it, I found it!
Haha! No problem here!
Now it's time to style!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
太好了，你终于
选好了！什么，你选了
哪一个来着？
啊，找到了，找到了！
哈哈！没问题！
现在该开始造型了！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Bwwwwaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Yap! Pwwwaaattt!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
啪！噗哇啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Waaaah!
Oh crap!
Wait, I can...
I can fix this!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇啊！
糟糕！
等等，我可以...
我可以补救的！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
^333333*Pant Pant Pant*^000000

[Assistant Beautician]
Bwahahaha! Success!
So... How do you like
your new style? I love it!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇哈哈！成功了！
那么...你觉得
新发型怎么样？我很喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Bwahahaha! Success!
Wha...? This isn't what
you wanted? Uh oh... Um...
Well, next time I know I can
do a much better job! Right!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇哈哈！成功了！
什...？这不是你
想要的吗？哎呀...嗯...
好吧，下次我肯定
能做得更好！对吧！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh, you're such a
sweetheart for helping
me! Thank you for using
my service and come again~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哦，你真是个
好心的家伙，帮了我大忙！
感谢使用我的服务，
欢迎下次再来~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Huh? Oh no, you're
quitting? Well, I guess
I couldn't trust me to
style my hair either...
You're... You're right.
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
咦？哦不，你要
放弃吗？好吧，看来
我也不能信任自己
给自己做发型了...
你...你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Prince Shammi?
He's only a genius when
it comes to hairstyling!
I'm just his apprentice, but
maybe someday, I can be a
force in the fashion world too!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
王子 沙米？
他只有在发型设计方面
才是天才！
我只是他的学徒，
但也许有一天，
我也能成为时尚界的一股力量！
